candidate_selection.selected_candidate: Parallelize the existing independent per-frame bicubic resize computations with at most four workers only for non-exact 16-frame video inputs. Preserve each frame's scalar bicubic arithmetic, output index, duplicated odd tail, dimensions, and subsequent serial packing. Keep exact-size and smaller-budget paths serial and unchanged.
candidate_selection.mechanism: The 68.209 ms packing stage includes a redundant second host resize for the 16-frame budget: historical FFmpeg scaling uses a fixed four-slice cap (256x480 here), while preprocessing correctly applies the eight-slice cap (224x448). Changing FFmpeg dimensions would change selected RGB and is forbidden. Each existing float resize is independent, so bounded frame-level parallelism reduces latency with bit-identical arithmetic and no reordering.

rejected_before_final_candidate.variant: direct patch pointers and 256-entry normalization LUT, then direct pointers with scalar normalization
rejected_before_final_candidate.result: NO_IMPROVEMENT; both variants reverted before the bounded-parallel candidate edit; exact semantic binaries passed and raw patches/profiles are retained externally

rejected_simd_variant.result: NO_PRIMARY_IMPROVEMENT; diagnostics established that 16-frame input is non-exact (FFmpeg 256x480 then host 224x448), so the SIMD exact-size path was unreachable. Reverted; exact semantic binaries passed and raw patch/profile retained externally

rejected_parallel_variant.variant: four-way exact-size temporal-slice parallelism for grid_t=8
rejected_parallel_variant.result: INSUFFICIENT_IMPROVEMENT; reverted before SIMD candidate edit; exact semantic binaries passed and raw patch/profile retained externally

candidate_selection.rule: Select at most one measured host/CUDA/FFmpeg bottleneck. Do not edit a runtime candidate before recording its mechanism and binding it to this protocol. If no plausible candidate can meet the primary gate, stop with diagnostic evidence.
forbidden_changes: training, optimizer, LoRA, and synthetic-geometry work
selector thresholds, ordering, budgets, anchors, source PTS, temporal-2 packing, mRoPE, model or sampling semantics
public request/response schemas, cancellation behavior, Task 61/66/72 controls
new media downloads, procedural substitutes, docs/index.html, and docs/assets/umminfer-showcase-*

profiling.order: seeded interleaving with seed 510075; identical schedule for every diagnostic build
decomposition: FFmpeg demux/decode, RGB conversion and scaling (one child boundary unless separately traced)
profiling.selection_rule: Choose a candidate only if its targeted stage is at least 25 ms median or 5 percent of native elapsed on natural-full-330 temporal-16 and the proposed transformation is exact by construction and testable.

live_workload.question: Describe the visible natural scenes and their order in one concise English sentence.
live_workload.finish_reason_note: Added after excluded preflight transport failures and before accepted traffic; the 32-token cap, prompt, and output parity are unchanged. Length is a valid real terminal, not a quality-scored answer.
live_workload.execution: For each mode run fresh baseline,candidate,candidate,baseline stacks (ABBA), completely stopping each stack before the next. Never run serial and batch-four concurrently.
live_workload.warmup_padding_per_stack: one extra default-8 request in every stack, marked warmup_padding, so batch-four warmup forms one complete group; serial receives the same padding
live_workload.arm_order: seeded interleaving with seed 510075; serial requests are sequential and batch-four uses seeded groups of four with no incomplete group
live_workload.pairing: Within each ABBA half, pair candidate and baseline by source, arm, repetition and seeded schedule position; preserve all 16 paired differences per mode/arm.
live_workload.pre_live_schedule_correction: Changed seven to eight measured repetitions and added equal warmup padding before any Task75 model traffic because 3*7 cannot form complete batch-four groups. No acceptance threshold or workload semantics changed.
live_workload.prefix_cache: disabled in every fresh native process; every request must log prefix_reused=0
live_workload.os_cache_policy: Weights and footage may be page-cache warm; every stack gets the same warmups. ABBA order limits monotonic cache/drift bias. No claim of cold-disk latency.
live_workload.cold_prefix_policy: All measured and warmup requests are cold-prefix. Reused-prefix results are excluded from throughput claims and fail the gate.

metrics.primary: serial natural-full-330 temporal-16 public total request latency, paired candidate-minus-baseline
metrics.distribution: Report count, median, nearest-rank p95, inclusive-quartile IQR, and median absolute deviation for every mode/arm/implementation and primary stage metric; retain min/max and every raw value externally.
metrics.paired_analysis: Report paired median/mean candidate-minus-baseline, median absolute paired delta, exact two-sided sign test over nonzero pairs, and deterministic percentile-bootstrap 95 percent interval for the median paired delta (20000 resamples, seed 510075).
metrics.outliers: Inclusive-quartile Tukey upper/lower fences within each mode/arm/implementation for total and native elapsed; retain all misses and outliers in every aggregate.
metrics.stability: Report coefficient of variation. A primary-cell CV above 0.10 invalidates an improvement claim for that run; repeat the complete affected ABBA mode once, retain both attempts, and do not pool attempts selectively.

performance: At least 25 ms and at least 5 percent lower primary paired median total latency.
Bootstrap 95 percent interval for primary median paired delta entirely below zero and exact two-sided sign-test p <= 0.05.
No secondary mode/arm has a median or p95 total-latency regression greater than 5 percent; any such result blocks a broad improvement claim and is reported explicitly.
semantics: Baseline/candidate selected RGB byte sequences and source-PTS sequences are exactly equal for all seven host arms on all profiled sources.
Temporal-2 pixel_values bytes, grid geometry, pair-first timestamps, prompt ids and mRoPE inputs/digests are exactly equal.
Every live candidate answer is byte-identical to its paired baseline answer; repeated outputs and serial/batch-four answers are exactly equal.
Default-8 remains identical to explicit uniform-8; first/last anchors, B-frame presentation order and all native evidence remain valid.
No assertion, threshold, timeout, source population, or quality criterion is weakened after results are seen.
controls: Run umm-test-local, native host/CUDA tests and focused red/green tests for the actual change.
Run the frozen Task72 natural gate on the candidate and independently compare its raw answers and native evidence to retained accepted baseline evidence.
Run unchanged Task66 deterministic/fixture controls; any unrun real-model Task66 replay remains NOT_RUN rather than being implied.
Independent fresh-process verification uses only raw evidence plus a complete self-excluded external manifest and does not import producer/scoring modules.

evidence.raw_location_policy: External task-owned evidence directory supplied by CLI; no task-specific absolute-path default in tracked files.
evidence.tracked: Preregistration, focused harness/tests, aggregate metrics, exact binary/model/source identities, negative results, external file counts, and manifest/report hashes only.
evidence.excluded_from_tracking: Per-frame blobs, per-request blobs, raw SSE corpora, large media, and newly generated static fixture corpora.
evidence.manifest: SHA-256 every external raw file, with the manifest and verification reports self-excluded by explicit relative-path rules.
